questions.prompt: Which US president resigned over the Watergate scandal?
questions.fact: He remains the only US president to resign the office, and was pardoned by his successor a month later.

questions.prompt: What kind of energy is stored in a stretched spring?
questions.fact: The same principle powers mechanical watches, where a coiled spring releases its store over roughly forty hours.

questions.prompt: How many rings must a gymnast use in the men's rings apparatus?
questions.fact: The rings must not visibly swing during a hold, so the difficulty is as much about stillness as strength.

questions.prompt: Which film is set largely on the planet Arrakis?
questions.fact: An earlier attempt to film it in the 1970s collapsed, but its concept art shaped science fiction design for decades.

questions.prompt: Which city is the largest in Canada by population?
questions.fact: More than half its residents were born outside Canada, one of the highest proportions of any large city on Earth.

questions.prompt: Which literary award is presented annually for fiction written in English and published in the UK?
questions.fact: It has been shared between two winners three times, after which the rules were changed to forbid it.

questions.prompt: Which measure describes how much data a connection can carry?
questions.fact: It is often confused with speed, but a high-bandwidth link with high latency still feels slow to use.
